voice.tooltip-idle: Voice to text — press Mod+S to record
voice.tooltip-recording: Recording — press Mod+S to stop and transcribe
voice.tooltip-no-speech: No speech detected — check your mic or speak up

toggle_command.label: Toggle command
toggle_command.description: Shell command run on click to start or stop a recording.

hide_when_idle.label: Hide when idle
hide_when_idle.description: Hide the indicator while voxtype is idle. It still appears to flag a take with no speech.

no_speech_warning_ms.label: No-speech warning (ms)
no_speech_warning_ms.description: How long the caution-toned mic stays after a recording ends without being transcribed.

pulse.label: Recording pulse
pulse.description: Breathe a red glow behind the mic while recording.

pulse_intensity.label: Pulse intensity
pulse_intensity.description: Peak opacity of the recording glow, from 0 to 1.
